project.profile.migration: Create one profile record and move project-specific values into typed fields or extensions.

roadmap.migration: Create one roadmap record; map sprint rows to sprint IDs and preserve release criteria.

sprint.migration: Create one sprint record per active sprint and exclude example directories from execution.

task.migration: Create one task record per active task; preserve a stable ID and normalize status/dependencies.

manual_action.migration: Create one record per Manual Action and never copy secret values into the record.

evidence.migration: Extract verification commands, result, commit and production evidence when present.

project.state.migration: Create canonical state from task records; keep TASK_STATUS.md as a human-readable legacy view until projection exists.
